gloss: only in the case of; precisely when; of all things, just when

definitions.gloss: (limiting) only; only in the case of; limited to
definitions.explanation: Marks a specific case or a restricted group as the only one that applies, excluding all others. Equivalent to 'only' or 'exclusively' and often used in formal notices and announcements.

definitions.gloss: (unexpected coincidence) of all times; precisely when; just when it was that
definitions.explanation: Used to express that a negative or inconvenient event happens at exactly the worst possible moment, or that someone normally reliable does something out of character. Conveys surprise, frustration, or irony about the timing or actor.

definitions.gloss: (confident denial) ... of all people; surely not X
definitions.explanation: Used with a negative or a rhetorical question to express strong confidence that the person or thing named would not do the thing in question. Often paired with はずがない or そんなことはない.

notes:
Formed from the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, the verb ⟦{限|かぎ}る→限る：02033_kagiru⟧ ('to limit') in its て-form, and an implicit reference back to the preceding noun. Structurally equivalent to 'limited to X' → 'only in the case of X', with two major extended uses for unexpected coincidences and confident denials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun] + に{限|かぎ}って — sense 1 and 2
- [noun] + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧ — a slightly more formal variant, especially common in signs and announcements; typically carries sense 1 only
- [noun (person)] + に{限|かぎ}って + ... ⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思う：00492_omou⟧ / ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — sense 3

SENSE 2 — UNEXPECTED COINCIDENCE:
With time expressions or situations, に{限|かぎ}って conveys the speaker's feeling that an inconvenient event happens specifically at the worst possible time. The tone is almost always emotional — frustrated, resigned, or ironic.

SENSE 3 — CONFIDENT DENIAL:
With a person's name or a group, に{限|かぎ}って expresses the speaker's strong belief that this particular person (unlike others) would not do the thing described. The clause that follows is nearly always negative in form or meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧に{限|かぎ}って: only today; precisely today
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧に{限|かぎ}って: only for members
- ～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{時|とき}に{限|かぎ}って: precisely when ...
- うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧に{限|かぎ}って: my child of all people
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}りません→限る：02033_kagiru⟧: is not limited to ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: only — general limiting particle; more neutral and does not carry the strong 'specifically this one' emphasis.
- ⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧: only — formal / written synonym of ⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧, similarly neutral.
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}る→限る：02033_kagiru⟧: to be limited to; to be the best — same verb, but used predicatively (e.g., ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}る→限る：02033_kagiru⟧, 'in summer, beer is the best').
- ～⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: only; nothing but — implies repetition or exclusivity of an activity; does not carry the 'of all times/people' nuance.
